title: Stagewise compact-support target comparison
statement: Fix the data and hypotheses of lem-sf-constructible-compact-support-target-iso. For systems S and S' and compactifications c and c', there is a family q indexed by common finite coefficient stages, with q_i : commonInclusion X i ⋙ (S.ring.operation c .closed).F ≅ commonInclusion X i ⋙ ((S'.ring.operation c' .closed).F ⋙ commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω e.hom), and q commutes with every common-stage transition isomorphism.

proof.text: Apply the finite rational geometric comparison to the ring and field projections of S and S'. It supplies a_i and the finite scalar square; no closed-coefficient comparison is assumed.

Use the existing normalized common-stage pullback descent. Its inclusion isomorphisms identify rational pullback followed by inclusion with inclusion followed by the fixed closed pullback. The image of a stage transition under its descended functor is the included rational transition comparison, as follows directly from the stage-morphism coherence equation.

Define q_i by composing the inverse commonComparison of S, inclusion of a_i, the pullback inclusion isomorphism, and commonComparison of S' whiskered by pullback, retaining all associators. Relabel the two commonCocycleLeft equations along the specified transition identifications. Paste these two squares with the rational scalar square and the pullback transition square. Naturality moves the inclusion and pullback factors; inverse cancellation proves the required transition equality. This is a complete categorical proof without further holes.

lean.statement: theorem constructible_compact_support_target_stage_comparison (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω] (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{max u v}) (hl : l ≠ D.p) {X Y Z : Scheme.{max u v}} [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Z.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Z ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)] (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : X ⟶ Z) (e : Y ≅ Z) (h : f ≫ e.hom = g) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [g.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g] (S : System.{u, v} l Ω D hl (f := f)) (c : Compactification f) (S' : System.{u, v} l Ω D hl (f := g)) (c' : Compactification g) : ∃ (q : ∀ i : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω, commonInclusion l Ω X i ⋙ (S.ring.operation c .closed).F ≅ commonInclusion l Ω X i ⋙ ((S'.ring.operation c' .closed).F ⋙ commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω e.hom)), ∀ {i j : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω} (hij : i ≤ j) (K : C.{u, v} l Ω X (.rational (commonField l Ω i))), (S.ring.operation c .closed).F.map (((stageSystem l Ω X).transIso hij).inv.app K) ≫ (q j).hom.app (((stageSystem l Ω X).T hij).obj K) = (q i).hom.app K ≫ ((S'.ring.operation c' .closed).F ⋙ commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω e.hom).map (((stageSystem l Ω X).transIso hij).inv.app K)
